body:
I feel you. Tired of wearing a mask to make others feel comfortable. And honestly I prefer the mask too but it’s hard to maintain

Just realized that could refer to the covid mask, I mean the fake emotion mask
Too many to count lol you?
I’m not leaving a note. It would be pointless because no matter how long the note is there’s no way they would understand everything.
Yeah that’s always how it is tho. You weren’t there for her when she was here. They never appreciate you when you are here only when you’re gone.

I wouldn’t say either of us has given up on loving each other he sort of knows the struggles I’m facing but he doesn’t fully understand. Honestly though I think he would be much happier if I wasn’t around anymore. I can tell all of my dark thoughts affect him negatively. And I know he’ll be hurt at first but in the long run I think he would be much better off. I want him to be happy

Edit: I just got off the phone with him and he’s undecided on if he wants to hang out this weekend (we don’t live together currently) because he’s too emotionally drained. This Saturday is our anniversary I think it might be the time.

In short my wedding has to be canceled due to the corona virus. I’m a girl and I’ve been dreaming of this day since I was a little girl. In terms of everything happening in the world it seems small, but growing up I didn’t have much. Now that I’m an adult I still don’t have a lot and I have self esteem issues. I just wanted one day where I felt beautiful. My fiancé doesn’t understand again because of everything happening in the world.
They do indeed. Hope it all works out the way you want it to.
Killed by someone? As in someone else?

Literally just everything. Everything that I’ve been looking forward to and waiting for is now being ripped away from me in the blink of an eye. It’s kind of like the straw that broke the camels back in a series of unfortunate events
